author: nastrondVI
quote:
The GTA series were respected for providing players the power of choice: be as much of a scumbag criminal as you like, hire prostitutes, steal every single vehicle in sight, store the ones that matter the most, burn and blow up the others, murder every human you want. You could hijack from someone in the middle of the road, run them over with it, pick a prostitute and take them somewhere discreet for a health buff, kill them afterwards and repeat the process if you're so inclined. These are not good things at all, but you were given the valuable choices to make your character do said not-good things and more. To top it all off, if you did feel like actually playing it for the plot you were still treated with entertaining and unforgettable characters and storylines between missions.

Not this game though! Instead what you have here is the single most anticipated video game of all time, featuring a Netflix Original Series-esque plot where you are obligated to play the good loyal boyfriend who needs to keep his unpleasant girlfriend happy. In a game called Grand Theft Auto you are now given much less freedom in regards to stealing and keeping vehicles. 

And the signature choice in committing represensable acts on your own terms, something all fans have appreciated since GTA3 (if not the classic entries before) is neutered. You'll find that, for the sake of keeping with the times and making this game as realistic as possible, many people who may or may not exhibit divisive agendas you may or may not agree with, are actually completely exempt from violence and destruction, granting them total immunity. Just like real life.

It was better off released under a new IP. But Rockstar knew perfectly well this cow was worthless milking out for over a decade without the GTA brand tacked onto it.

1 undeserved point out of 10 for actually finishing and releasing the damn thing. Now let's hope the overblown hysteria completely dies sooner than later.

Hurry up with ES6, Bethesda. I'm not holding much hope there either, but surely you can't do any worse than this.
